headline: Credo showcases lower-power optical cables for AI data centers
summary: Credo Technology unveiled new optical cables designed to consume roughly 30% less power than traditional copper cables used in data centers.
why: Energy-efficient data center hardware is increasingly critical for managing the soaring power consumption demands of artificial intelligence infrastructure.

impacts.name: Credo Technology
impacts.why: Energy-efficient data center hardware addresses critical power consumption demands of artificial intelligence infrastructure.
